'''Gummies''' are the currency of Oob.
[[File:Gummies Bundle (Large).png|thumb|Gummies]]

== Obtaining ==
* Scanning new [[Ooblets]] at the [[Lernery]]
* Selling crops and forageables at [[Meed's Seeds]]
* Selling food at [[Cuddlecups Cafe]]
* Fulfilling [[Plenny's]] orders
* [[Sea dangling]]
*Reward for obtaining a new [[Friendship Sticker]]

== Uses ==
* Buying seeds at [[Meed's Seeds]]
* Buying clothes and accessories at [[Kibbonbon]]
* Buying furniture or house upgrades at [[Manatwee]]
* Buying [[Beanjuice]], [[Spressy]], or [[Ground Springbeans]] at [[Cuddlecups Cafe]]
